{{Quote|Me? I'm a security chief. I don't know nothin' about nobody. I just look at the manifests.|Mozo Bondog, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MB" />}}
'''Mozo Bondog''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he operated out of the [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] [[Dathomir Imperial Prison|Imperial Prison]] as the [[Chief of Security/Legends|chief of security]].<ref name="SWG:MB" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mozo Bondog was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
